full_judgment:
Mustafa Kamal, J: At the instance of respondent No. 1, a defendant in Title Suit No. 137 of 1993 pending in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka and at the instance of respondent Nos. 2 and 3 who are defendant in Title Suit No. 131 of 1993 pending in the 4th Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka Miscellaneous Case No. 7 of 1994 under section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure was filed in the Court of District Judge, Dhaka for transfer of the said Title Suit No. 137 of 1993, Title Suit No. 131 of 1993, Title Suit No. 71 of 1993 pending before the 3rd Additional Assistant Judge, Dhaka Miscellaneous Case No. 37 of 1992 arising out of Title Suit No. 309 of 1989 pending before the 4th Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka and Execution Case No. 1 of 1993 pending before the Arbitration Judge, Dhaka for analogous hearing and trial in the Court of competent jurisdiction. By Order No. 9 dated 5.3.94 the learned District Judge, Dhaka dismissed the application. The said respondents preferred Civil Revision No. 3463 of 1994 against the said judgment and order of the learned District Judge. By judgment and order dated 10.2.97 a Division Bench of the High Court Division made the Rule absolute and directed that all the suits be tried analogously by one Court. 

 6. It is however desirable that evidence should be taken separately in respect of five different suits and cases and judgment should also be pronounced separately taking into consideration the evidence adduced in each particular suit and case. Evidence in one suit or case shall not be taken as evidence in the other suits or cases.
